prompt.alinti: Comment "SKILLS" to get step by step install guide.
Claude Skills can help turn repetitive work into reusable workflows.
From coding and research to writing, data analysis, document creation, and everyday tasks, the right skills can help you automate more of your workflow and save time.
Instead of doing the same task manually every time, build a workflow Claude can repeat for you.
Save this list for your Claude toolkit.
Follow for more Claude Skills, AI tools, automation ideas, and productivity tips.

yontem.ne: Gives Claude control of a real browser to visit websites, click buttons, fill out forms, and pull data off pages.
yontem.alinti: Gives Claude control of a real browser. It can visit websites, click buttons, fill out forms, and pull data off pages - the exact grunt work you'd normally do by hand, one tab at a time.

yontem.ne: Cleans up messy folders by renaming files in bulk, sorting them, converting formats, and processing hundreds of files faster than manual handling.
yontem.alinti: Cleans up messy folders for you. Renames files in bulk, sorts them into the right places, converts formats, and processes hundreds of files the way you'd process one - just far faster.

yontem.ne: Does the initial research for you by gathering sources, reading through them, and providing a clear summary for a strong starting point.
yontem.alinti: Does the first few hours of research for you. Give it a topic, and it gathers sources, reads through them, and hands you a clear summary - a strong starting point, not the final word.

yontem.ne: Takes messy spreadsheets and turns them into useful data by cleaning inconsistent data, running analysis, and building clear reports.
yontem.alinti: Takes a messy spreadsheet and turns it into something useful. Cleans inconsistent data, runs the analysis, and builds a clear report - no more fighting with pivot tables by hand.

yontem.ne: Transforms raw research or rough notes into publishable content like blog posts, scripts, or captions in the required format.
yontem.alinti: Takes raw research or rough notes and turns them into something publishable - a blog post, a script, a caption - in whatever format you actually need to ship today.

yontem.ne: Adapts one idea into content tailored for every platform, handling format differences and publishing workflows.
yontem.alinti: Adapts one idea into content for every platform, since what works on LinkedIn falls flat on Instagram. Handles the format differences and the publishing workflow around each one.

yontem.ne: Turns rough ideas into a design brief by outlining specs, sizes, color direction, and asset lists for designers.
yontem.alinti: Turns a rough idea into a real design brief - specs, sizes, color direction, an asset list - the groundwork a designer needs before they even open a design tool.

yontem.ne: Breaks down multi-step tasks into automated workflows, handling repetitive tasks that you keep putting off.
yontem.alinti: The master skill that ties everything together. Instead of doing the same multi-step task by hand every single time, this breaks it down and runs it automatically - the repetitive stuff you keep putting off.
